Subject: Proforma + 50% advance request for Small Biz Roundtable (11/12)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for selecting Olive Events to run the Small Business Roundtable on Nov 12. Attached is the proforma invoice and a short supplier onboarding checklist. To secure the venue and caterer we need a 50% deposit (standard industry practice).

Key items:
- Total estimated cost: $14,800 (venue + basic AV + light catering)
- Requested deposit: $7,400 (wire or card) due by 10/15 to hold date
- Refund policy: 75% refund if canceled >45 days; 50% between 14–45 days; non-refundable <14 days

We can accept a Redwood PO and invoice match for reconciliation — I attached the proforma (OliveEvents_Proforma_Invoice_1007.pdf). Let me know if you need a vendor W-9 or insurance certificate; I can send both.

Thanks,
Suzanne Clark
Director, Client Events
Olive Events

Marissa / Laura / Ben — forwarding Olive's request. Two asks:
1) Can Finance approve a 50% vendor advance for this regional publisher roundtable? Event budget sits on Q4 marketing discretionary; we have headcount and registration targets tied to this.
2) If approved, please confirm spend cap (we expect final invoiced amount ~ $14.8k) and the cost center / ledger coding we should use so Marissa can issue PO.

Notes: this is a small roundtable (60 pax) — we plan to invite 30 customers + 30 prospects. We need to lock venue by Friday 10/15. Olive is happy to accept PO + wire.

Priyom — Finance OK to approve a 50% advance under these conditions:
- Advance capped at $7,400 (50% of proforma). Any additional services must have pre-approval.
- PO must include line items that match proforma (venue, AV, catering) and reference deal_id EVT-2026-089.
- Cost center: 4301-FieldMkt (use GL code 6120 for events) and project tag RB-ROUND-110/26
- Payment method: preferred via ACH to vendor bank on file. If card is used, notify AP for fee treatment.
- Require vendor W-9 and Cert of Insurance before wire release.
- For refund handling: if cancellation occurs, Finance will reconcile final vendor credit against accruals; any refunds to Redwood will net against the event expense bucket.

Marissa: once you confirm PO number and upload vendor docs to the vendor portal, we will route the advance through AP and schedule wire for 10/15.

Ben Carter
